description:
Evolve the Chinook database schema to support a new customer loyalty program. Working with the database at '/home/ga/Documents/databases/chinook_loyalty.db', you must:

1. Connect to the database in DBeaver (connection name 'ChinookLoyalty').
2. Alter the 'customers' table to add columns: 'LoyaltyTier' (TEXT), 'TotalSpend' (REAL), 'JoinDate' (TEXT).
3. Create a 'loyalty_rewards' table with columns: RewardId (PK), CustomerId (FK), Tier, DiscountPercent, Description.
4. Backfill customer data: Calculate TotalSpend (sum of invoices) and JoinDate (earliest invoice). Assign LoyaltyTier based on spend: Gold (>=45.00), Silver (38.00-44.99), Bronze (30.00-37.99), None (<30.00).
5. Populate 'loyalty_rewards' with 1 row per tiered customer (Gold=15%, Silver=10%, Bronze=5% discount).
6. Export a summary CSV to '/home/ga/Documents/exports/loyalty_summary.csv' showing LoyaltyTier, CustomerCount, TotalRevenue, AvgSpend, sorted by revenue descending.
7. Save your SQL migration script to '/home/ga/Documents/scripts/loyalty_migration.sql'.
